decision.explanation: The documents present conflicting population figures for East Brooklyn depending on location and time: 1,473 at the 2000 census for East Brooklyn, Connecticut; 5,000 for the same area; and 106 at the 2010 census for East Brooklyn, Illinois. These refer to different places and times, hence each is independently valid.
